name: My Roommates Are Vampires
source:
My Roommates Are Vampires is a supernatural Boys' Love visual novel filled with romance, humor, mystery, and a whole lot of NSFW chaos.

After being kicked out by his family for coming out as gay, Adrian transfers to Jaxville College in search of a fresh start. Broke, alone, and carrying his entire life in a single suitcase, he takes a chance on the only affordable room he can find: a stunning lakeside house on the outskirts of town.

The catch? His four new roommates are as mysterious as they are irresistible.

There's Taehyung, the warm and supportive life coach who seems to hold the household together. Jett, an endlessly energetic college swimmer with a sweet tooth and no sense of personal boundaries. Romeo, a muscular baker with a heart as soft as his cupcakes. And Daemon, a brooding artist whose sharp tongue hides secrets darker than Adrian can imagine.

When Adrian accidentally overhears a tense midnight conversation, he becomes convinced he's moved in with a group of murderers. The truth is far more unbelievable... His roommates are vampires.

Now Adrian must navigate his first semester of college while living with four dangerously attractive immortals, uncovering the secrets that destroyed their reputation, deciding who he can trust, and perhaps even falling in love.
